text: Drag a selection box to command multiple squad members at once.
Press Ctrl+1..4 to assign control groups, and 1..4 to recall them.
Use Attack-Move (A + click) so your squad engages enemies spotted along the road.
Double-tap a control group key to center the camera on that squad.
On touchscreens, long-press on the ground or an enemy to issue a right-click command.
Use two fingers to pan the battlefield camera and pinch to zoom.
Keep archers and mages behind shield-bearing infantry to avoid flanking pounces.
Briar Hounds and Tollhouse Ghouls take bonus damage from fire spells and torches.
Armored beasts like Flintbacks resist arrows—use lightning magic or heavy maces.
Watch enemy telegraphs: stepping sideways before a charge saves half your squad.
Set your mage's autocast spell to keep steady pressure without micromanagement.
Focus down enemy healers and blood-chanters before grinding through frontline brutes.
Sell surplus white-tier loot in town to fund mercenary contracts and potion belts.
Check town taverns after every mission—reputation unlocks cheaper mercenary hires.
Repair worn armor at the town smithy before marching into multi-wave sieges.
Identify mysterious items in town or with scrolls to reveal hidden resistances.
Mercenaries carry their own charm slot and two auto-triggering healing potions.
Activate roadside shrines to grant temporary blessings or restore squad stamina.
Scouts reveal fog of war farther ahead—send one before crossing narrow bridges.
Break crates and inspect abandoned camps for extra gold and lore notes.
Balanced attributes keep your hero alive; Body adds HP while Mind deepens mana.
Equipping matching Set pieces unlocks bonus stats shown in the Hall of Relics.
Socket runes and gems into open item slots to cover elemental weaknesses.
Side quests often offer moral choices that shift town prices or ally strength.
In Thornwick, Sergeant Garrick and Old Fenwick often disagree—listen to both.
Don't wade blindly into Sunken Ford reeds; clear hound packs from dry ground.
In Redmarsh alkali pans, shatter lime-casks to cleanse Hexer Saelen's poison stacks.
Strike all three Silver Tally-Altars in the Salt-Vaults to strip Khepri's ward.
Water and lightning spells crack Overlord Gorrathul's salt-crusted carapace.
Use Guard stance on pikemen to hold choke points without chasing runners.
Retreating a wounded mercenary early saves gold compared to hiring a replacement.
Elevation matters: ranged units firing downhill gain better sightlines.
Poison and bleed effects bypass thick armor—great against slow quarry beasts.
Use Export Save in the menu to back up your campaign file across devices.
Download chapter packs from the Storage screen to play Thornvael offline.
Not every tavern rumor is true—cross-check wild claims against your journal.
The Codex tracks every monster, unique relic, and boss you encounter.
Listen for horn blasts and spell chimes—audio cues warn of off-screen threats.
Higher difficulties boost enemy damage and speed, but reward richer loot.
Pause anytime with Space or the HUD button to queue orders calmly.
